name: [💥] Miami Streets
desc:
🔥 Welcome to Miami Streets !

Build your reputation as you rise through the city, take on challenges, and make your mark in an ever-changing world. With intense action, unique combat moments, and nonstop opportunities, every decision shapes your path to the top.
The question is: will you rise to the top or be left behind?

- Console Supported 🎮
– Rob banks and houses 💰
– Join a faction and take over turfs for prizes ⚔️
– Hunt for weapons and cash 🔫
– Purchase your own apartment 🏠
– Drive and Upgrade Cars 🚗
– And So Much More❗


CONTROLS:
R2 TO SHOOT 
L2 TO SPRINT
